verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents an official MCP server that connects AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude. The server loads GrowthBook Agent Skills and makes authenticated calls to the REST API, and a probe independently confirms the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an agent actually connecting and operating through the MCP server, plus deeper detail on the tool surface and setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude to GrowthBook using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
The official GrowthBook MCP server is a thin bridge: it loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated calls to the GrowthBook REST API.
